units.zh: 志第二十七 百官四
units.en: Treatise 27: The Bureaucracy, Part Four.
units.literal: Treatise twenty-seven: Officials, part four.

units.zh: 执金吾 太子太传 大长秋 太子少傅 将作大匠 城门校尉 北军中候 司隶校尉
units.en: The Bearer of the Gilded Mace, the heir's grand tutor, the empress's chamberlain, the heir's junior tutor, the master of works, the colonel of the gates, the northern-army middle commandant, and the colonel director of retainers.
units.literal: Bearer of the gilded mace; grand tutor of the heir; grand prolonger of autumn; junior tutor of the heir; master artisan; colonel of the gates; middle commandant of the northern army; colonel director of retainers.

units.zh: 城门校尉北军中候司隶校尉
units.en: The colonel of the gates, the northern-army middle commandant, and the colonel director of retainers.
units.literal: Colonel of the gates, middle commandant of the northern army, colonel director of retainers.

units.en: The Bearer of the Gilded Mace was a single post at two thousand piculs, middle rate.
units.literal: One bearer of the gilded mace, salary of two thousand piculs at the middle grade.

units.zh: 本注曰：掌宫外戒司非常水火之事。
units.en: He patrolled outside the palace walls, watched for emergencies, and dealt with fires, floods, and other crises.
units.literal: Original note says: He is charged with outside the palace alerting and controlling unusual matters of fire and water.

units.zh: 月三绕行宫外，及主兵器。
units.en: Each month his men circled the palace perimeter three times, and he also controlled the armory.
units.literal: Each month three circuits are made around outside the palace, and he is also in charge of weapons.

units.en: The word wu in the title is glossed as being akin to "imperial equipage," that is, imperial guard.
units.literal: "Wu" is like "imperial chariot."

units.en: He had one assistant at the thousand-picul level.
units.literal: One assistant, salary comparable to one thousand piculs.

units.en: Two hundred mounted guards in the brown riding coats served under him.
units.literal: Two hundred cavalry in red-brown.

units.en: They held no formal rank but were fed at rates similar to clerical stipends.
units.literal: Original note says: They have no rank; their sustenance is comparable to clerks' salaries.

units.en: The capital arsenal director held six hundred piculs.
units.literal: One director of the arsenal, six hundred piculs.

units.en: He stored and issued arms.
units.literal: Original note says: He is in charge of weapons.

units.en: There was one assistant.
units.literal: One assistant.

units.en: The foregoing offices reported to the Bearer of the Gilded Mace.
units.literal: Those on the right belong to the bearer of the gilded mace.

units.zh: 本注曰：本有式道、左右中候三人，六百石。
units.en: There had originally been three six-hundred-picul commandants who cleared the route for the imperial train.
units.literal: Original note says: Originally there were three middle commandants of the model road, left, right, and center, six hundred piculs.

units.zh: 车驾出，掌在前清道，还持麾至宫门，宫门乃开。
units.en: On outings they rode ahead to clear the streets; on the return they carried the signal banner to the gate before the doors would open.
units.literal: When the chariot train goes out, they are in charge ahead of clearing the road; returning, they hold the banner to the palace gate, and only then does the palace gate open.

units.zh: 中兴但一人，又不常置，每出，以郎兼式道候，事已罢，不复属执金吾。
units.en: After the restoration only one such post remained, and it was often left vacant; gentlemen were temporarily detailed as route commandants for each procession, then released and no longer under the Bearer of the Gilded Mace.
units.literal: At the restoration there was only one person, and moreover it was not constantly established; each time there was an outing, gentlemen took concurrent duty as model-road commandants; when the affair was finished, they were dismissed and no longer belonged to the bearer of the gilded mace.

units.zh: 又省中垒、寺互、都船令、丞、尉及左右京辅都尉。
units.en: The central bastion, prison liaison, capital boat pool, and the left and right metropolitan auxiliary commands were also cut.
units.literal: Further abolished were the central rampart, temple mutual, capital boats director, assistants, commandants, and left and right metropolitan auxiliary commandants.

units.zh: 太子太傅一人，中二千石。
units.en: The heir's grand tutor was a single minister at two thousand piculs, middle rate.
units.literal: One grand tutor of the heir, salary of two thousand piculs at the middle grade.

units.en: His role was to guide and teach the crown prince.
units.literal: Original note says: His duty is to assist and instruct the heir.

units.en: He was honored like a tutor but commanded no separate bureaucracy.
units.literal: Rites are as for a teacher; he does not head official subordinates.

units.en: The empress's chamberlain, the grand prolonger of autumn, held two thousand piculs.
units.literal: One grand prolonger of autumn, two thousand piculs.

units.en: The office descended from the Qin "general who goes"; it was held by a eunuch.
units.literal: Original note says: Inherited from Qin's general who goes; eunuchs.

units.zh: 景帝更为大长秋，或用士人。
units.en: Emperor Jing renamed it grand prolonger of autumn and occasionally appointed a civil official.
units.literal: Emperor Jing changed it to grand prolonger of autumn; sometimes literati were used.

units.zh: 中兴常用宦者，职掌奉宣中宫命。
units.en: After the restoration eunuchs normally held the post and conveyed the empress's orders.
units.literal: At the restoration eunuchs were commonly used; the duty is to receive and proclaim the commands of the middle palace.

units.zh: 凡给赐宗亲，及宗亲当谒见者关通之，中宫出则从。
units.en: He arranged stipends for the imperial clan, passed in kinsmen who sought audience, and accompanied the empress when she left the palace.
units.literal: As for all grants and gifts to imperial kin, and imperial kin who ought to have audience, he links and communicates them; when the middle palace goes out, he follows.

units.en: He had one assistant at six hundred piculs.
units.literal: One assistant, six hundred piculs.

units.en: The assistant was a eunuch.
units.literal: Original note says: Eunuchs.

units.en: The empress's chief steward held one thousand piculs.
units.literal: One steward of the middle palace, one thousand piculs.

units.en: The steward was a eunuch.
units.literal: Original note says: Eunuchs.

units.en: He managed the empress's carriage horses and drivers.
units.literal: He is in charge of driving.

units.zh: 本注曰：太仆，秩二千石，中兴省「太」，减秩千石，以属长秋。
units.en: The post had been the grand coachman at two thousand piculs; the restored Han dropped the word "grand," cut the salary by one thousand piculs, and subordinated it to the chamberlain.
units.literal: Original note says: Grand coachman, rank two thousand piculs; at the restoration "grand" was removed, rank was reduced by one thousand piculs, and it was placed under the prolonger of autumn.

units.zh: 中宫谒者令一人，六百石。
units.en: The director of the empress's ushers held six hundred piculs.
units.literal: One director of ushers of the middle palace, six hundred piculs.

units.en: He was a eunuch.
units.literal: Original note says: Eunuchs.

units.en: Three palace ushers served at four hundred piculs each.
units.literal: Three ushers of the middle palace, four hundred piculs.

units.en: They were eunuchs.
units.literal: Original note says: Eunuchs.

units.en: They transmitted memorials to and from the empress's quarters.
units.literal: They are in charge of reporting memorials within.

units.en: Five secretariat clerks for the empress's household held six hundred piculs.
units.literal: Five masters of writing of the middle palace, six hundred piculs.

units.en: They were eunuchs.
units.literal: Original note says: Eunuchs.

units.en: They kept the empress's correspondence and records.
units.literal: They are in charge of documents within.

units.zh: 中宫私府令一人，六百石。
units.en: The director of the empress's private treasury held six hundred piculs.
units.literal: One director of the private treasury of the middle palace, six hundred piculs.

units.en: The director was a eunuch.
units.literal: Original note says: Eunuchs.

units.zh: 主中藏币帛诸物，裁衣被补浣者皆主之。
units.en: He stored silk and valuables for the harem and oversaw tailors, menders, and laundresses.
units.literal: He is in charge of goods stored within of silks and coins and the various things; cutting garments and bedding and those who patch and wash—all are under him.

units.en: There was one assistant.
units.literal: One assistant.

units.en: The assistant was a eunuch.
units.literal: Original note says: Eunuchs.

units.zh: 中宫永巷令一人，六百石。
units.en: The warden of the empress's Everlasting Lane held six hundred piculs.
units.literal: One director of the Everlasting Lane of the middle palace, six hundred piculs.

units.en: The warden was a eunuch.
units.literal: Original note says: Eunuchs.

units.en: He supervised palace women attached to the empress.
units.literal: He is in charge of palace women.

units.en: There was one assistant.
units.literal: One assistant.

units.en: The assistant was a eunuch.
units.literal: Original note says: Eunuchs.

units.zh: 中宫黄门冗从仆射一人，六百石。
units.en: The chief of the empress's supernumerary Yellow Gate escorts held six hundred piculs.
units.literal: One supervisor of supernumerary followers among attendants at the Yellow Gates of the middle palace, six hundred piculs.

units.en: He was a eunuch.
units.literal: Original note says: Eunuchs.

units.en: He commanded the empress's extra inner Yellow Gate attendants.
units.literal: He is in charge of supernumerary followers among attendants at the Yellow Gates Within.

units.en: The superintendent of the empress's compound offices held six hundred piculs.
units.literal: One director of offices of the middle palace, six hundred piculs.

units.en: He was a eunuch.
units.literal: Original note says: Eunuchs.

units.en: He processed petitions and gate clearances for the empress's bureaus and kept count of the emperor's visits to her quarters.
units.literal: He is in charge of requests to offices of the middle palace and the count of the Son of Heaven.

units.zh: 女骑六人，丞、复道丞各一人。
units.en: There were six mounted female guards, one deputy, and one deputy for the elevated corridors.
units.literal: Six female riders; one assistant and one assistant of the covered walk, each one person.

units.en: These deputies were eunuchs.
units.literal: Original note says: Eunuchs.

units.en: The elevated-walk deputy maintained the palace skyways and galleries.
units.literal: The assistant of the covered walk is in charge of the covered passages within.

units.en: The empress's chief apothecary held four hundred piculs.
units.literal: One chief of medicine of the middle palace, four hundred piculs.

units.en: He was a eunuch.
units.literal: Original note says: Eunuchs.

units.en: The foregoing offices belonged to the empress's chamberlain.
units.literal: Those on the right belong to the grand prolonger of autumn.

units.zh: 本注曰：承秦，有詹事一人，位在长秋上，亦宦者，主中诸官。
units.en: Under Qin there had been a eunuch superintendent of the heir ranking above the chamberlain and overseeing inner-court agencies.
units.literal: Original note says: Inherited from Qin, there was one superintendent of the heir, position above the prolonger of autumn, also a eunuch, in charge of the various offices within.

units.zh: 成帝省之，以其职并长秋。
units.en: Emperor Cheng abolished it and folded its functions into the grand prolonger of autumn.
units.literal: Emperor Cheng abolished it and merged its duties into the prolonger of autumn.

units.zh: 是后皇后当法驾出，则中谒、中宦者职吏权兼詹事奉引，讫罢。
units.en: Thereafter, when the empress rode in state, inner ushers and eunuch clerks temporarily doubled as superintendents to lead the cortège, then stood down.
units.literal: After this, when the empress ought to go out with the regulated chariot train, then inner ushers and inner eunuch duty clerks concurrently by authority act as superintendent leading the train; when finished, they are dismissed.

units.zh: 宦者诛后，尚书选兼职吏一人奉引云。
units.en: After the eunuch purges the Secretariat picked a part-time clerk to lead the train instead.
units.literal: After the eunuchs were executed, the masters of writing selected one concurrent-duty clerk to lead the train, it is said.

units.zh: 其中长信、长乐宫者，置少府一人，职如长秋，及余吏皆以宫名为号，员数秩次如中宫。
units.en: At Changxin and Changle a privy treasurer was appointed like the chamberlain, and staff took titles from the palace name with the same ranks as the empress's household.
units.literal: As for those of enduring faith and perpetual joy palaces, one privy treasurer is established; duties are as the prolonger of autumn, and the remaining clerks all take the palace name as title; quotas, numbers, ranks, and order are as the middle palace.

units.zh: 本注曰：帝祖母称长信宫，故有长信少府，长乐少府，位在长秋上，及职吏皆宦者，秩次如中宫。
units.en: The emperor's grandmother took the title Changxin palace, hence Changxin and Changle privy treasurers outranked the chamberlain; their eunuch staff mirrored the empress's establishment.
units.literal: Original note says: The emperor's grandmother was titled enduring faith palace; therefore there was enduring faith privy treasurer, perpetual joy privy treasurer, position above the prolonger of autumn, and duty clerks were all eunuchs; ranks and order as the middle palace.

units.zh: 长乐又有卫尉，仆为太仆，皆二千石，在少府上。
units.en: Changle also had its own commandant of guards and a grand coachman at two thousand piculs, both senior to the privy treasurer.
units.literal: Perpetual joy also had a commandant of the guards; the steward was grand coachman; all were two thousand piculs, above the privy treasurer.

units.en: Those offices were abolished at her death and were not permanent.
units.literal: When she dies, then they are abolished; not constantly established.

units.en: The heir's junior tutor held two thousand piculs.
units.literal: Junior tutor of the heir, two thousand piculs.

units.zh: 本注曰：亦以辅导为职，悉主太子官属。
units.en: He too instructed the crown prince but actually commanded the heir's entire staff.
units.literal: Original note says: Also his duty is to assist and instruct; he wholly heads the heir's official subordinates.

units.en: The crown prince's master of the watch rotation held one thousand piculs.
units.literal: One director of the heir's rotation of watches, one thousand piculs.

units.zh: 本注曰：主庶子、舍人更直，职似光禄。
units.en: He scheduled rotating duty for the prince's cadets and attendants, much like the superintendent of the palace did for gentlemen.
units.literal: Original note says: He is in charge of cadet sons and attendants rotating duty; duties resemble those of the superintendent of the palace.

units.en: The crown prince's cadet sons were ranked at four hundred piculs.
units.literal: Cadet sons of the heir, four hundred piculs.

units.zh: 本注曰：无员，如三署中郎。
units.en: Their number was not fixed; they corresponded to gentlemen of the interior in the three corps.
units.literal: Original note says: There is no fixed quota; they are like gentlemen of the interior of the three bureaus.

units.en: The crown prince's attendants held two hundred piculs.
units.literal: Attendants of the heir, two hundred piculs.

units.zh: 本注曰：无员，更直宿卫，如二署郎中。
units.en: There was no fixed quota; they stood rotating night watch like gentlemen of the interior in the two corps.
units.literal: Original note says: There is no fixed quota; they rotate duty standing night guard; they are like gentlemen of the interior of the two bureaus.

units.en: The crown prince's major-domo held one thousand piculs.
units.literal: One steward of the heir's household, one thousand piculs.

units.zh: 本注曰：主仓穀饮食，职似司农、少府。
units.en: He ran the heir's granaries and kitchens like a miniature minister of finance and privy treasurer.
units.literal: Original note says: He is in charge of granaries, grain, drink, and food; duties resemble those of the minister of finance and privy treasurer.

units.en: The crown prince's granary director held six hundred piculs.
units.literal: One director of the heir's granary, six hundred piculs.

units.en: He managed stored grain for the heir apparent.
units.literal: Original note says: He is in charge of granaries and grain.

units.zh: 太子食官令一人，六百石。
units.en: The crown prince's catering director held six hundred piculs.
units.literal: One director of the heir's food office, six hundred piculs.

units.en: He supplied the heir's table.
units.literal: Original note says: He is in charge of drink and food.

units.en: The crown prince's coachman ranked at one thousand piculs.
units.literal: One steward of the heir, one thousand piculs.

units.zh: 本注曰：主车马，职如太仆。
units.en: He handled the heir's stables and carriages like the imperial grand coachman.
units.literal: Original note says: He is in charge of chariots and horses; duties are as the grand coachman.

units.en: The chief groom of the heir's stables held four hundred piculs.
units.literal: One chief of the heir's stables, four hundred piculs.

units.en: He oversaw the heir's horses and vehicles.
units.literal: Original note says: He is in charge of chariots and horses.

units.en: The crown prince's gate grandee held six hundred piculs.
units.literal: Gate grandee of the heir, six hundred piculs.

units.zh: 本注曰：《旧注》云职比郎将。
units.en: An old commentary compares the post to a captain of the guard.
units.literal: Original note says: The old note says duties are comparable to a captain of the guard.

units.zh: 旧有左右户将，别主左右户直郎，建武以来省之。
units.en: Formerly left and right household captains had commanded the door guards, but Emperor Guangwu abolished them.
units.literal: Formerly there were left and right household generals, separately in charge of left and right household gentlemen on duty; from Jianwu onward they were abolished.

units.en: The crown prince's palace cadets held six hundred piculs.
units.literal: Palace cadets of the heir, six hundred piculs.

units.zh: 本注曰：员五人，职如侍中。
units.en: There were five posts, analogous to gentlemen-in-attendance at court.
units.literal: Original note says: Quota of five persons; duties are like gentlemen-in-attendance.

units.en: The crown prince's grooms-of-the-stirrup were ranked at six hundred piculs.
units.literal: Groomsmen who wash the horses of the heir, salary comparable to six hundred piculs.

units.zh: 本注曰：《旧注》云员十六人，职如谒者。
units.en: Old notes give sixteen men with duties like court ushers.
units.literal: Original note says: The old note says quota of sixteen persons; duties are like ushers.

units.zh: 太子出，则当直者在前导威仪。
units.en: When the heir left the palace, those on duty rode ahead to clear the way and display his train.
units.literal: When the heir goes out, then those on duty go ahead in front leading deportment.

units.en: The crown prince's inner shield commander held four hundred piculs.
units.literal: One inner shield of the heir, four hundred piculs.

units.en: He commanded the heir's close escort and patrols around the residence.
units.literal: Original note says: He is in charge of encircling guard and patrol.

units.en: The crown prince's guard captain held four hundred piculs.
units.literal: One guard leader of the heir, four hundred piculs.

units.en: He commanded the guards at the heir's gates.
units.literal: Original note says: He is in charge of gate guardsmen.

units.en: The offices listed above reported to the heir's junior tutor.
units.literal: Those on the right belong to the junior tutor of the heir.

units.zh: 本注曰：凡初即位，未有太子，官属皆罢，唯舍人不省，领属少府。
units.en: When a new emperor had not yet named an heir, the heir's bureaucracy was disbanded except for attendants, who stayed on under the Privy Treasurer.
units.literal: Original note says: Whenever one first ascends the throne and there is not yet an heir, official subordinates are all dismissed; only attendants are not reduced; they are led and belong to the Privy Treasurer.

units.en: The master of works was a single minister at two thousand piculs.
units.literal: One master artisan, two thousand piculs.

units.zh: 本注曰：承秦，曰将作少府，景帝改为将作大匠。
units.en: The office came from Qin as the privy treasurer of works; Emperor Jing renamed it master of works.
units.literal: Original note says: Inherited from Qin, called privy treasurer of works; Emperor Jing changed it to master artisan.

units.zh: 掌修作宗庙、路寝、宫室、陵园木土之功，并树桐梓之类列于道侧。
units.en: He built and repaired imperial temples, inner halls, palaces, and mausoleum parks, and lined roadsides with paulownia and catalpa.
units.literal: He is in charge of repair and construction of ancestral temples, route resting chamber, palaces, and mausoleum parks, works of timber and earth, and also planting paulownia, catalpa, and the like arrayed beside the roads.

units.en: He had one assistant at six hundred piculs.
units.literal: One assistant, six hundred piculs.

units.en: The director of the left convict-labor camp held six hundred piculs.
units.literal: One director of the left works camp, six hundred piculs.

units.en: He supervised convict laborers assigned to the left camp.
units.literal: Original note says: He is in charge of left work convicts.

units.en: There was one assistant.
units.literal: One assistant.

units.en: The director of the right convict-labor camp held six hundred piculs.
units.literal: One director of the right works camp, six hundred piculs.

units.en: He supervised convict laborers assigned to the right camp.
units.literal: Original note says: He is in charge of right work convicts.

units.en: There was one assistant.
units.literal: One assistant.

units.en: These offices were under the master of works.
units.literal: Those on the right belong to the master artisan.

units.zh: 城门校尉一人，比二千石。
units.en: The colonel of the gates was ranked at two thousand piculs.
units.literal: One colonel of the gates, salary comparable to two thousand piculs.

units.zh: 本注曰：掌雒阳城门十二所。
units.en: He commanded the twelve gates of Luoyang.
units.literal: Original note says: He is in charge of the twelve gates of Luoyang.

units.en: His chief of staff held one thousand piculs.
units.literal: One major, one thousand piculs.

units.en: The major commanded the gate garrisons.
units.literal: Original note says: He is in charge of soldiers at the gates.

units.en: Each gate had a warden at six hundred piculs.
units.literal: For each gate one gatekeeper, six hundred piculs.

units.zh: 本注曰：雒阳城十二门，其正南一门曰平城门，北宫门属卫尉。
units.en: Luoyang had twelve gates; the southernmost was Pingcheng Gate, while the north palace gate came under the commandant of the guards.
units.literal: Original note says: Luoyang city has twelve gates; the one due south is called Pingcheng Gate; the north palace gate belongs to the commandant of the guards.

units.zh: 其余上西门，雍门，广阳门，津门，小苑门，开阳门，粍门，中东门，上东门，穀门，夏门，凡十二门。
units.en: The other eleven gates were Upper West, Yong, Guangyang, Ferry, Small Garden, Kaiyang, Haomen, Central East, Upper East, Grain, and Summer; with Pingcheng Gate they made twelve.
units.literal: The rest: Upper West Gate, Yong Gate, Guangyang Gate, Ferry Gate, Small Garden Gate, Kaiyang Gate, Haomen, Central East Gate, Upper East Gate, Grain Gate, Summer Gate—in all twelve gates.

units.en: These posts belonged to the colonel of the gates.
units.literal: Those on the right belong to the colonel of the gates.

units.en: The middle commandant of the northern army held six hundred piculs.
units.literal: One middle commandant of the northern army, six hundred piculs.

units.en: He inspected the five northern-army camps.
units.literal: Original note says: He is in charge of supervising the five camps.

units.zh: 屯骑校尉一人，比二千石。
units.en: The colonel of garrison cavalry was ranked at two thousand piculs.
units.literal: One colonel of garrison cavalry, salary comparable to two thousand piculs.

units.en: He commanded the camp's palace guard detachment.
units.literal: Original note says: He is in charge of standing guard soldiers.

units.en: Each camp had a major at one thousand piculs.
units.literal: One major, one thousand piculs.

units.zh: 越骑校尉一人，比二千石。
units.en: The colonel of Wuyue cavalry held rank at two thousand piculs.
units.literal: One colonel of barbarian cavalry, salary comparable to two thousand piculs.

units.en: He commanded that camp's guard troops.
units.literal: Original note says: He is in charge of standing guard soldiers.

units.en: There was one major at one thousand piculs.
units.literal: One major, one thousand piculs.

units.zh: 步兵校尉一人，比二千石。
units.en: The colonel of foot soldiers held two thousand piculs.
units.literal: One colonel of foot soldiers, salary comparable to two thousand piculs.

units.en: He commanded the foot camp's guards.
units.literal: Original note says: He is in charge of standing guard soldiers.

units.en: There was one major at one thousand piculs.
units.literal: One major, one thousand piculs.

units.zh: 长水校尉一人，比二千石。
units.en: The colonel of the Long Water Hu cavalry held two thousand piculs.
units.literal: One colonel of long-water, salary comparable to two thousand piculs.

units.en: He commanded that camp's guard detachment.
units.literal: Original note says: He is in charge of standing guard soldiers.

units.zh: 司马、胡骑司马各一人，千石。
units.en: There were a camp major and a Hu-cavalry major, each at one thousand piculs.
units.literal: One major and one major of Hu cavalry, each one thousand piculs.

units.zh: 本注曰：掌宿卫，主乌桓骑。
units.en: The camp provided palace guard and included Wuhuan horsemen.
units.literal: Original note says: He is in charge of standing guard; he is in charge of Wuhuan cavalry.

units.zh: 射声校尉一人，比二千石。
units.en: The colonel of hidden archers held two thousand piculs.
units.literal: One colonel of archers who sound the shot, salary comparable to two thousand piculs.

units.en: He commanded that camp's guard archers.
units.literal: Original note says: He is in charge of standing guard soldiers.

units.en: There was one major at one thousand piculs.
units.literal: One major, one thousand piculs.

units.en: These five colonels answered to the northern-army middle commandant.
units.literal: Those on the right belong to the middle commandant of the northern army.

units.zh: 本注曰：旧有中垒校尉，领北军营垒之事。
units.en: Formerly a colonel of the central bastion had overseen the northern camps' fortifications.
units.literal: Original note says: Formerly there was a colonel of the central rampart, in charge of northern army camp rampart affairs.

units.zh: 有胡骑、虎贲校尉，皆武帝置。
units.en: Emperor Wu had also created separate Hu-cavalry and tiger-rushers colonels.
units.literal: There were colonels of Hu cavalry and tiger-rushers; all were established by Emperor Wu.

units.zh: 中兴省中垒，但置中候，以监五营。
units.en: The restored Han abolished the central bastion colonel and used only the middle commandant to supervise the five camps.
units.literal: At the restoration the central rampart was abolished; only the middle commandant was established, in order to supervise the five camps.

units.en: The Hu-cavalry colonelcy was merged into the Long Water command.
units.literal: Hu cavalry was merged into long-water.

units.en: The tiger-rushers' light chariots were folded into the hidden-archers regiment.
units.literal: Tiger-rushers were in charge of light chariots; merged into sounding-the-shot.

units.en: Ministers at two thousand piculs middle rate had assistants at one thousand piculs.
units.literal: As for middle two thousand piculs, assistants are comparable to one thousand piculs.

units.zh: 真二千石，丞、长史六百石。
units.en: True two-thousand-picul posts had assistants and chief clerks at six hundred piculs.
units.literal: True two thousand piculs: assistants and chief clerks six hundred piculs.

units.en: Two-thousand-picul nominal ranks had assistants at six hundred piculs.
units.literal: Comparable to two thousand piculs: assistants comparable to six hundred piculs.

units.en: County magistrates and kingdom chancellors at one thousand piculs had assistants and commandants at four hundred;
units.literal: Directors and chancellors one thousand piculs; assistants and commandants four hundred piculs;

units.en: at six hundred piculs the deputies and commandants were at three hundred.
units.literal: Those at six hundred piculs: assistants and commandants three hundred piculs.

units.zh: 长、相四百石及三百石，丞、尉皆二百石。
units.en: Magistrates and chancellors at four hundred or three hundred piculs had assistants and commandants at two hundred.
units.literal: Chiefs and chancellors at four hundred piculs and three hundred piculs: assistants and commandants all two hundred piculs.

units.zh: 诸侯、公主家丞，秩皆比百石。
units.en: Stewards of princely and princess households were ranked at about one hundred piculs.
units.literal: Household assistants of marquises and princesses: ranks all comparable to one hundred piculs.

units.zh: 诸边鄣塞尉、诸陵校尉长，皆二百石。
units.en: Frontier blockhouse commandants and mausoleum wardens held two hundred piculs.
units.literal: Commandants of the various border stockades and passes, colonels and chiefs of the various mausolea: all two hundred piculs.

units.en: Established posts with fixed precedent are not given explicit salary grades here.
units.literal: Those with constant precedent do not have rank written.

units.zh: 司隶校尉一人，比二千石。
units.en: The colonel director of retainers was ranked at two thousand piculs.
units.literal: One colonel director of retainers, salary comparable to two thousand piculs.

units.zh: 本注曰：孝武帝初置，持節，掌察举百官以下，及京师近郡犯法者。
units.en: Emperor Wu first created the post with a credential baton to impeach capital officials and wrongdoers in the home commanderies around Luoyang.
units.literal: Original note says: Emperor Wu at first established it; he held the staff of authority; he is in charge of investigating and reporting all officials downward and those who violate the law in the capital region and neighboring commanderies.

units.zh: 元帝去節，成帝省，建武中复置，并领一州。
units.en: Emperor Yuan stripped the baton; Emperor Cheng abolished the office; Emperor Guangwu restored it and added authority over one province.
units.literal: Emperor Yuan removed the staff; Emperor Cheng abolished it; in the Jianwu era it was restored and also headed one province.

units.en: He had twelve attendants.
units.literal: Twelve attendant clerks.

units.zh: 本注曰：都官从事，主察举百官犯法者。
units.en: The capital-bureau attendant impeached metropolitan officials who broke the law.
units.literal: Original note says: Capital bureau attendant: in charge of investigating and reporting officials who violate the law.

units.zh: 功曹从事，主州选署及众事。
units.en: The merit clerk handled provincial appointments and general administration.
units.literal: Merit bureau attendant: in charge of provincial selections and appointments and the multitude of affairs.

units.zh: 别驾从事，校尉行部则奉引，录众事。
units.en: The separate-car attendant led the colonel's inspection tours and kept his records.
units.literal: Separate-car attendant: when the colonel inspects departments, then he leads the train and records the multitude of affairs.

units.en: The accounts clerk managed fiscal ledgers and grain registers.
units.literal: Ledger bureau attendant: in charge of ledgers of wealth, grain, and documents.

units.zh: 其有军事，则置兵曹从事，主兵事。
units.en: In wartime a military-affairs clerk was added to the staff.
units.literal: If there is military affairs, then a military bureau attendant is established, in charge of military affairs.

units.zh: 其餘部郡国从事，每郡国各一人，主督促文书，察举非法，皆州自辟除，故通為百石云。
units.en: Each commandery and kingdom also had one provincial clerk to push paperwork and report abuses; provinces hired them locally, so they were loosely treated as hundred-picul posts.
units.literal: As for the remaining department commandery-kingdom attendants, each commandery and kingdom each has one person, in charge of urging documents, investigating and reporting what is unlawful; all are personally recruited by the province; therefore collectively they are called one hundred piculs, it is said.

units.en: There were twenty-five subordinate aides.
units.literal: Twenty-five deputy assistants.

units.zh: 本注曰：主簿录阁下事，省文书。
units.en: The chief clerk managed office business under the colonel and vetted correspondence.
units.literal: Original note says: The chief clerk records affairs below the gate tower and examines documents.

units.en: The gate chief enforced provincial discipline at headquarters.
units.literal: Gate pavilion chief is in charge of provincial rectification.

units.en: The merit clerk's aide handled personnel selection.
units.literal: Gate merit bureau document assistant is in charge of selection and appointment.

units.en: The Classic of Filial Piety instructor supervised classical examinations.
units.literal: Master of the Classic of Filial Piety is in charge of supervising examination of the classics.

units.en: The Monthly Ordinances specialist oversaw seasonal temple rites.
units.literal: Master of the Monthly Ordinances is in charge of seasonal sacrifices.

units.en: The statute specialist advised on legal interpretation.
units.literal: Master of statutes and ordinances is in charge of leveling the laws.

units.en: The accounts clerk's aide kept the ledgers.
units.literal: Ledger bureau document assistant is in charge of ledgers and documents.

units.zh: 其余都官书佐及每郡国，各有典郡书佐一人，各主一郡文书，以郡吏补，岁满一更。
units.en: Each commandery also supplied a resident clerk for its documents, rotated annually from local officials.
units.literal: As for the remaining capital bureau document assistants and for each commandery and kingdom, each has one commandery classic document assistant, each in charge of one commandery's documents; they are filled from commandery clerks; when the year is full, one rotation.

units.en: The colonel director of retainers oversaw seven commanderies.
units.literal: The colonel director of retainers' department commanderies are seven.

units.zh: 河南尹一人，主京都，特奉朝请。
units.en: The governor of Henan ran the capital and held standing right to imperial audience.
units.literal: One governor of Henan, in charge of the capital metropolis, specially granted court audience.

units.zh: 其京兆尹、左冯翊、右扶风三人，汉初都长安，皆秩中二千石，谓之三辅。
units.en: The metropolitan governor and the two flank commanderies around Chang'an had each ranked at two thousand piculs middle rate and were called the Three Guardians of the capital.
units.literal: As for the governor of the capital district, left Fengyi, and right Fufeng, three persons—at the beginning of Han the capital was at Chang'an; all ranks were middle two thousand piculs; they are called the three auxiliaries.

units.zh: 中兴都雒阳，更以河南郡为尹，以三辅陵庙所在，不改其号，但减其秩。
units.en: After the move to Luoyang Henan became a metropolitan governorship; the old Three Guardians kept their names to tend western tombs but were demoted in salary.
units.literal: At the restoration the capital was Luoyang; Henan commandery was changed to governor; because the three auxiliaries were where mausolea and temples were located, their titles were not changed, but only their rank was reduced.

units.zh: 其餘弘农、河内、河东三郡。
units.en: The other three commanderies in his circuit were Hongnong, Henei, and Hedong.
units.literal: The remainder: Hongnong, Henei, Hedong, three commanderies.

units.zh: 其置尹，冯翊、扶风及太守丞奉之本位，在《地理志》。
units.en: The full tables for metropolitan governors, Fengyi, Fufeng, and county magistrates appear in the Treatise on Geography.
units.literal: As for the establishment of governors, Fengyi, Fufeng, and the fundamental positions of grand administrators and assistants are in the Treatise on Geography.
